title: I Took the Neighbor's Leaf-Blower Hours to the City Noise Site

parts.text: He started the blower at 6:12 a.m. on a Sunday, which the city site said was not a time that existed for blowers. I was forty-five, holding a mug, standing in a robe that had no diplomacy. I recorded thirty seconds, filed the form, and went back to bed. A city email landed Monday. He blew at 9:40 after that, which is ugly and legal. I can hate legal. I cannot hate a timestamp that works. The mug still has a chip. Sundays have a new quiet that starts after 9. I will take 9. Robes are not ordinances. Forms are.

social.video_title: 6:12 a.m. Sunday met a form and became 9:40 — Part 1/1
social.description: Robe, mug, thirty seconds of evidence. Would you have knocked on his door first?
